segments.text:
V. 4.
It is written—Thus Chriſt anſwered, and thus we may anſwer all the Suggeſtions of the Devil. By every word that proceed•th out of the mouth of GOD—That is, by whatever GOD commands to ſuſtain him. Therefore it is not needful I ſhould work a Miracle to procure Bread, without any Intimation of my Father's Will.
